_comment: Shared conformance vectors for bundle_config_hash adapter_options canonicalization (issue #1542). Loaded by the Rust gateway (`packages/sie_gateway/src/types/model.rs`), the sie_config config service (`_canonical_adapter_options`), and the sie_server worker (`api.ws._compact_adapter_options_for_hash`). A divergence here makes a worker's advertised bundle_config_hash never match the gateway's expected hash, leaving it in pending_workers forever. `strip_to_none` and `keep_unchanged` exercise the GENERIC flat canonicalizers (gateway + config service), which strip an options map to None when every value is falsy (null/false/0/0.0/""/[]/{}) and otherwise drop empty nested maps. `transform` exercises the loadtime/runtime compaction that real profiles use (adapter_options is always shaped {loadtime, runtime}); all three implementations — including the worker, whose canonicalizer is loadtime/runtime-structured rather than flat — must agree on it.
